desc: Thompson 1927a-1 "deluxe Semi-auto" All The Classic Details Of The Time Honored Original Are Reproduced In Today's Semi-auto Thompson. The Frame And Receiver Are Machined From Solid Steel. The Wood Is Genuine American Walnut. This .45 Caliber Carbine Features A 16 1/2" Finned Barrel, Compensator And Is Available With A Blued Steel Receiver. This Configuration Is Our Most Popular.
